q: 商店里___很多人。
zh: 商店里有很多人。
py: shāng diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén
en: There are a lot of people in the shop.
why: The place opens the sentence and 很多人 is a new, unspecified group, so 有 is the verb. 在 needs the thing first and the place after it, and 没有 would say there are no people, contradicting the meaning.

q: 超市门口___三辆自行车。
zh: 超市门口有三辆自行车。
py: chāo shì mén kǒu yǒu sān liàng zì xíng chē
en: There are three bicycles at the supermarket entrance.
why: Place first plus a counted new thing (三辆自行车) means 有. 在 cannot follow a place and then introduce a counted noun.

q: 公园附近___体育馆，只有一个很小的游泳池。
zh: 公园附近没有体育馆，只有一个很小的游泳池。
py: gōng yuán fù jìn méi yǒu tǐ yù guǎn zhǐ yǒu yī gè hěn xiǎo de yóu yǒng chí
en: There is no gym near the park, only a very small swimming pool.
why: Saying a thing does not exist in a place is 没有 plus a bare noun. 不有 does not exist, and 不在 needs the thing first (体育馆不在公园附近).

q: 那家新开的鞋店里___各种各样的运动鞋，价格也不贵。
zh: 那家新开的鞋店里有各种各样的运动鞋，价格也不贵。
py: nà jiā xīn kāi de xié diàn lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de yùn dòng xié jià gé yě bù guì
en: The newly opened shoe shop has all kinds of sports shoes, and the prices are not high either.
why: Place first, then a new and indefinite set of things (各种各样的运动鞋): 有. 在 would need the shoes in front and a location after it.

q: 我家附近的体育馆里___一个游泳池和两个羽毛球场。
zh: 我家附近的体育馆里有一个游泳池和两个羽毛球场。
py: wǒ jiā fù jìn de tǐ yù guǎn lǐ yǒu yī gè yóu yǒng chí hé liǎng gè yǔ máo qiú chǎng
en: The gym near my home has a swimming pool and two badminton courts.
why: The sentence lists what a place contains, starting from the place, so it takes 有. 在 would make the pool and courts the topic and point to a place after the verb.

q: 我的球鞋___门后面。
zh: 我的球鞋在门后面。
py: wǒ de qiú xié zài mén hòu miàn
en: My sports shoes are behind the door.
why: 我的球鞋 is a known thing placed first, so its location is stated with 在. 有 would need the place at the start, and 是 would not say where it is.

q: 收银台___商店的左边。
zh: 收银台在商店的左边。
py: shōu yín tái zài shāng diàn de zuǒ biān
en: The checkout counter is on the left side of the shop.
why: The counter is a known thing placed first, and its position is the news, so 在. 有 and 是 cannot sit between a known thing and a place.

q: 你要买的那双鞋___三楼。
zh: 你要买的那双鞋在三楼。
py: nǐ yào mǎi de nà shuāng xié zài sān lóu
en: The pair of shoes you want to buy is on the third floor.
why: 你要买的那双鞋 is a specific known pair, so it comes first and 在 gives its location. 有 would introduce a new thing and needs the place in front.

q: 小王的羽毛球拍___哪儿？
zh: 小王的羽毛球拍在哪儿？
py: xiǎo wáng de yǔ máo qiú pāi zài nǎ r
en: Where is Xiao Wang's badminton racket?
why: Asking the location of a known thing is 在哪儿. 有哪儿 and 是哪儿 do not ask where something is.

q: 我昨天看中的那件运动服___二楼的女装区旁边。
zh: 我昨天看中的那件运动服在二楼的女装区旁边。
py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn zhòng de nà jiàn yùn dòng fú zài èr lóu de nǚ zhuāng qū páng biān
en: The sports jacket I liked yesterday is next to the women's clothing section on the second floor.
why: The jacket is already known (我昨天看中的那件), so it goes first and is located with 在. Putting 有 after a known thing is ungrammatical.

q: 篮球场对面___李老师的家。
zh: 篮球场对面是李老师的家。
py: lán qiú chǎng duì miàn shì lǐ lǎo shī de jiā
en: Across from the basketball court is Teacher Li's home.
why: The place comes first and the named occupant follows, so 是 identifies what is there. 在 needs the thing before it, not the place.

q: 我家后面___一个很大的体育馆。
zh: 我家后面是一个很大的体育馆。
py: wǒ jiā hòu miàn shì yī gè hěn dà de tǐ yù guǎn
en: Behind my home is a very big gym.
why: Place first, then naming what is there: 是. 在 would only work with the thing in front (体育馆在我家后面).

q: 这条街的左边全___卖运动用品的商店，右边都是饭馆。
zh: 这条街的左边全是卖运动用品的商店，右边都是饭馆。
py: zhè tiáo jiē de zuǒ biān quán shì mài yùn dòng yòng pǐn de shāng diàn yòu biān dōu shì fàn guǎn
en: The left side of this street is all shops selling sports goods, and the right side is all restaurants.
why: 全是 and 都是 say a place is filled with one kind of thing, and the parallel clause uses 是 too. 全在 is not a pattern with a place in front.

q: 手机在桌子___。
zh: 手机在桌子上。
py: shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
en: The phone is on the table.
why: A table is an object and needs a location word; the phone rests on its surface, so 上. 里 would put it inside the table, and nothing at all leaves 桌子 as a plain object.

q: 钱在包___。
zh: 钱在包里。
py: qián zài bāo lǐ
en: The money is in the bag.
why: 包 is an object, so it needs a location word, and the money is inside, so 里. 上 would mean on the outside surface.

q: 饮料在冰箱___。
zh: 饮料在冰箱里。
py: yǐn liào zài bīng xiāng lǐ
en: The drinks are in the fridge.
why: 冰箱 is an object, not a place by itself, so after 在 it needs 里. Leaving it bare is the classic mistake (在冰箱).

q: 他在上海___买了一件运动服。
zh: 他在上海买了一件运动服。
py: tā zài shàng hǎi mǎi le yī jiàn yùn dòng fú
en: He bought a sports jacket in Shanghai.
why: 上海 is a city name and already a place, so nothing is added after it. 里 and 上 are never put after a city.

q: 我哥哥在北京___学打网球。
zh: 我哥哥在北京学打网球。
py: wǒ gē gē zài běi jīng xué dǎ wǎng qiú
en: My older brother is learning to play tennis in Beijing.
why: City names are places already, so no 里 after 北京. English "in" is fully covered by 在.

q: 价格写在这张小纸___。
zh: 价格写在这张小纸上。
py: jià gé xiě zài zhè zhāng xiǎo zhǐ shàng
en: The price is written on this small piece of paper.
why: Writing sits on a flat surface, so 上 goes after 纸. 里 would put it inside the paper, and 外 would put it outside the paper.

q: 球票放在我的书包___。
zh: 球票放在我的书包里。
py: qiú piào fàng zài wǒ de shū bāo lǐ
en: The match ticket is in my school bag.
why: A bag holds things inside, so 里 after 书包. 上 would put the ticket on the outside of the bag, and 外 would be outside it.

q: 教练把比赛名单写在黑板___。
zh: 教练把比赛名单写在黑板上。
py: jiào liàn bǎ bǐ sài míng dān xiě zài hēi bǎn shàng
en: The coach wrote the match list on the blackboard.
why: Chinese uses 上 for things written on a board; 黑板里 would mean inside it and bare 黑板 is not a place.

q: 我把新买的球拍挂在墙___，这样孩子拿不到。
zh: 我把新买的球拍挂在墙上，这样孩子拿不到。
py: wǒ bǎ xīn mǎi de qiú pāi guà zài qiáng shàng zhè yàng hái zi ná bù dào
en: I hung the newly bought racket on the wall so the children cannot reach it.
why: Something hung on a wall is on its surface, so 墙上. 墙里 would put it inside the wall, and 墙旁 is not a word.

q: 我小时候在广州___学会了游泳，后来才搬到上海。
zh: 我小时候在广州学会了游泳，后来才搬到上海。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu zài guǎng zhōu xué huì le yóu yǒng hòu lái cái bān dào shàng hǎi
en: I learned to swim in Guangzhou as a child and only later moved to Shanghai.
why: 广州 is a city and already a place, so it takes no 里, even in a longer sentence.

q: 咖啡店在体育馆___。
zh: 咖啡店在体育馆旁边。
py: kā fēi diàn zài tǐ yù guǎn páng biān
en: The coffee shop is next to the gym.
why: The cue says "next to", which is 旁边. 对面 means across from and 中间 means between, which needs two reference points.

q: 我的自行车停在商店___，不在里面。
zh: 我的自行车停在商店外面，不在里面。
py: wǒ de zì xíng chē tíng zài shāng diàn wài miàn bù zài lǐ miàn
en: My bike is parked outside the shop, not inside it.
why: The second clause says it is not inside, so the word is 外面. 里面 contradicts it and 中间 needs two things to be between.

q: 这家鞋店在银行和超市___。
zh: 这家鞋店在银行和超市中间。
py: zhè jiā xié diàn zài yín háng hé chāo shì zhōng jiān
en: This shoe shop is between the bank and the supermarket.
why: Two reference nouns joined by 和 take 中间. 对面 and 附近 work with one reference point.

q: 游泳池在公园___，走路五分钟就到。
zh: 游泳池在公园附近，走路五分钟就到。
py: yóu yǒng chí zài gōng yuán fù jìn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào
en: The swimming pool is near the park, five minutes on foot.
why: A five-minute walk means near, not adjacent, so 附近. 旁边 means right beside it, and 后面 gives a direction the sentence never mentions.

q: 教练站在我们___。
zh: 教练站在我们前面。
py: jiào liàn zhàn zài wǒ men qián miàn
en: The coach is standing in front of us.
why: The cue says in front of us: 前面 follows the reference word 我们. 后面 is the opposite direction.

q: 超市___有一家很大的运动用品店。
zh: 超市对面有一家很大的运动用品店。
py: chāo shì duì miàn yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn
en: Across from the supermarket there is a big sports goods shop.
why: Reference noun plus location word gives 超市对面. 面对 and 对着 are verbs, not location words, so they cannot form the place at the start.

q: 球场门口一直站___几个小朋友。
zh: 球场门口一直站着几个小朋友。
py: qiú chǎng mén kǒu yī zhí zhàn zhe jǐ gè xiǎo péng yǒu
en: A few children have been standing at the entrance of the pitch all along.
why: 一直 shows a continuing state, so 站着. 了 marks a completed change, and 过 marks a past experience, neither of which goes with 一直.

q: 我们教室的墙上挂___一张很大的球赛海报。
zh: 我们教室的墙上挂着一张很大的球赛海报。
py: wǒ men jiào shì de qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng hěn dà de qiú sài hǎi bào
en: On the wall of our classroom hangs a big match poster.
why: Place + verb + 着 + new thing is the pattern for a state. 挂在 would need the thing in front and the place after it, and 过 reports a past experience.

q: 货架上摆___很多新到的球鞋。
zh: 货架上摆着很多新到的球鞋。
py: huò jià shàng bǎi zhe hěn duō xīn dào de qiú xié
en: Many newly arrived sports shoes are displayed on the shelves.
why: Place first, a verb with 着, then the new thing. 摆在 would put the place after the verb with the things in front.

q: 柜台上放___三瓶饮料。
zh: 柜台上放着三瓶饮料。
py: guì tái shàng fàng zhe sān píng yǐn liào
en: There are three bottles of drink on the counter.
why: Place + 放着 + counted thing describes what is lying there. 在 cannot attach to a verb in front of a counted noun in this order.

q: 昨天我们队来___一个新教练。
zh: 昨天我们队来了一个新教练。
py: zuó tiān wǒ men duì lái le yī gè xīn jiào liàn
en: A new coach joined our team yesterday.
why: A newcomer after the verb needs 了, as this happened yesterday. 着 would describe a continuing state, and 的 cannot mark a completed event.

q: 我们学校旁边上个月新开___一个游泳馆。
zh: 我们学校旁边上个月新开了一个游泳馆。
py: wǒ men xué xiào páng biān shàng gè yuè xīn kāi le yī gè yóu yǒng guǎn
en: A new swimming pool opened next to our school last month.
why: A shop or pool newly appearing is a completed event, so 开了 with the new thing after the verb. 着 describes a continuing state and 过 an experience; neither fits 上个月新开 here.

q: 我们公司走___三个人，现在只剩五个人。
zh: 我们公司走了三个人，现在只剩五个人。
py: wǒ men gōng sī zǒu le sān gè rén xiàn zài zhǐ shèng wǔ gè rén
en: Three people have left our company; now only five remain.
why: Three people departing is a completed change, so 走了 with the leavers after the verb. 着 would be a continuing state and 过 would be a past experience.

q: 商店门口突然出现___一大群人，大家都在等打折。
zh: 商店门口突然出现了一大群人，大家都在等打折。
py: shāng diàn mén kǒu tū rán chū xiàn le yī dà qún rén dà jiā dōu zài děng dǎ zhé
en: A big crowd suddenly appeared at the shop entrance; everyone was waiting for the sale.
why: 突然 marks a sudden event, completed: 出现了 plus the new crowd after the verb. 着 does not go with 突然, and 过 is not about a sudden single event.

q: 冰箱里___饮料了。
zh: 冰箱里没有饮料了。
py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu yǐn liào le
en: There are no more drinks in the fridge.
why: Non-existence is 没有 plus a bare noun. 不有 does not exist, and 不在 needs the drink in front as a known thing.

q: 老板今天___店里。
zh: 老板今天不在店里。
py: lǎo bǎn jīn tiān bù zài diàn lǐ
en: The boss is not in the shop today.
why: A known person not being at a place is 不在 with the place after it. 没有 would negate possession or existence, not location.

q: 我的球拍___桌子上，你再找找。
zh: 我的球拍不在桌子上，你再找找。
py: wǒ de qiú pāi bù zài zhuō zi shàng nǐ zài zhǎo zhǎo
en: My racket is not on the table; look again.
why: A known thing not at a place is 不在. 没有 cannot directly negate a place phrase after a known thing, and 不是 would deny an identity.

zh: 超市旁边有一家体育用品店。
py: chāo shì páng biān yǒu yī jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
en: There is a sports shop next to the supermarket.
why: Place first, then 有, then the new counted thing. The shop is indefinite, so it cannot open the sentence with 在.

zh: 房间里有两个足球。
py: fáng jiān lǐ yǒu liǎng gè zú qiú
en: There are two footballs in the room.
why: Existence starts with the place (房间里) and ends with the new counted thing. The number and noun come after 有, never before the place.

zh: 商场里有很多买运动鞋的人。
py: shāng chǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō mǎi yùn dòng xié de rén
en: There are many people buying sports shoes in the mall.
why: New people announced in a place: place + 有 + 很多 + noun phrase. The long noun phrase stays after 有.

zh: 我的球鞋在床下面。
py: wǒ de qiú xié zài chuáng xià miàn
en: My sports shoes are under the bed.
why: A known thing (我的球鞋) goes first and 在 places it; the place cannot start the sentence with 在 after it.

zh: 你的运动包在沙发后面。
py: nǐ de yùn dòng bāo zài shā fā hòu miàn
en: Your sports bag is behind the sofa.
why: 你的运动包 is definite, so it comes first and 在 gives its place. The location word 后面 follows 沙发.

zh: 小王在游泳池旁边。
py: xiǎo wáng zài yóu yǒng chí páng biān
en: Xiao Wang is next to the swimming pool.
why: A named person goes first, then 在, then the reference noun, and 旁边 after the reference noun, not before it.

zh: 银行在超市和书店中间。
py: yín háng zài chāo shì hé shū diàn zhōng jiān
en: The bank is between the supermarket and the bookshop.
why: 中间 follows both reference nouns, as in 超市和书店中间. English puts "between" first; Chinese puts it last.

zh: 体育馆对面是一家咖啡店。
py: tǐ yù guǎn duì miàn shì yī jiā kā fēi diàn
en: Across from the gym is a coffee shop.
why: Place first, 是 introduces what occupies it. 在 cannot follow a place, and the reference noun stays before 对面.

zh: 我家后面是我常去打球的那个公园。
py: wǒ jiā hòu miàn shì wǒ cháng qù dǎ qiú de nà ge gōng yuán
en: Behind my home is the park where I often play ball.
why: The occupant is definite (那个公园), so 是 is the verb after the place. 有 would be unnatural with a known park.

zh: 门口站着一个卖球票的人。
py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī gè mài qiú piào de rén
en: Someone selling match tickets is standing at the entrance.
why: Place first, 站着, then the new person. The person cannot come before 站着, and 着 is not followed by a place.

zh: 橱窗里挂着一件红色运动服。
py: chú chuāng lǐ guà zhe yī jiàn hóng sè yùn dòng fú
en: A red sports jacket hangs in the shop window.
why: Place + verb with 着 + counted new thing. 挂着 stays in front of the thing because the order is state first, thing last.

zh: 桌子上放着两瓶水。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe liǎng píng shuǐ
en: There are two bottles of water on the table.
why: Place at the start, 放着 next, then number-measure-noun last.

zh: 商场里来了很多买东西的人。
py: shāng chǎng lǐ lái le hěn duō mǎi dōng xī de rén
en: A lot of shoppers have arrived in the mall.
why: Place first, then 来了, and the newcomers last. Putting the people before the verb would make them a known group.

zh: 昨天商店里来了一位老客人。
py: zuó tiān shāng diàn lǐ lái le yī wèi lǎo kè rén
en: An old customer came to the shop yesterday.
why: The time word and place both open the sentence, in either order, and 一位老客人 follows 来了.

zh: 上个月对面新开了一家体育用品店。
py: shàng gè yuè duì miàn xīn kāi le yī jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
en: A new sports goods shop opened across the street last month.
why: The time and place go before the verb, in either order, and the new shop comes last after 新开了.

zh: 商店里没有人。
py: shāng diàn lǐ méi yǒu rén
en: There is nobody in the shop.
why: Place + 没有 + bare noun. No number or measure word follows 没有 in the plain negative.

zh: 我的球拍不在桌子上。
py: wǒ de qiú pāi bù zài zhuō zi shàng
en: My racket is not on the table.
why: A known thing not at a place is 不在, with the thing first and the place last.

zh: 书店里没有运动杂志。
py: shū diàn lǐ méi yǒu yùn dòng zá zhì
en: There are no sports magazines in the bookshop.
why: Non-existence is 没有 with the place first and a bare noun last.

zh: 经理今天不在办公室。
py: jīng lǐ jīn tiān bù zài bàn gōng shì
en: The manager is not in the office today.
why: The known person comes first or after 今天, then 不在 and the place. 不在 negates location; 没有 would negate existence.

zh: 球场旁边有一家小卖部。
py: qiú chǎng páng biān yǒu yī jiā xiǎo mài bù
en: There is a small shop next to the pitch.
why: Reference noun + 旁边 forms the place, then 有 and the new counted thing.

zh: 你昨天买的那双球鞋在衣柜最下面。
py: nǐ zuó tiān mǎi de nà shuāng qiú xié zài yī guì zuì xià miàn
en: The pair of sports shoes you bought yesterday is at the very bottom of the wardrobe.
why: The long definite phrase 你昨天买的那双球鞋 goes first, then 在 and the place. 有 cannot take a known thing.

zh: 球迷站在教练后面。
py: qiú mí zhàn zài jiào liàn hòu miàn
en: The fans are standing behind the coach.
why: The location word follows its reference: 教练后面, not 后面教练. 站在 comes directly before the reference.

zh: 他在北京打网球。
py: tā zài běi jīng dǎ wǎng qiú
en: He plays tennis in Beijing.
why: 北京 is a city and takes no 里. Placing 在北京 before the verb gives where the playing happens.

zh: 牛奶在冰箱里。
py: niú nǎi zài bīng xiāng lǐ
en: The milk is in the fridge.
why: 冰箱 is an object and needs 里 after it. 上 would put the milk outside the fridge.

zh: 我们学校后面有一个可以踢足球的小操场。
py: wǒ men xué xiào hòu miàn yǒu yī gè kě yǐ tī zú qiú de xiǎo cāo chǎng
en: Behind our school there is a small field where one can play football.
why: Place first, 有, then a new counted thing with a long modifier. The modifier must stay inside the noun phrase after 有.

src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè lán qiú
task: Say there is no basketball (没有).
zh: 桌子上没有篮球。
py: zhuō zi shàng méi yǒu lán qiú
en: There is no basketball on the table.
why: 没有 negates 有, and the number-measure 一个 is dropped in the plain negative.

src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
zh: 我的手机不在桌子上。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī bù zài zhuō zi shàng
en: My phone is not on the table.
why: The positive uses 在, so the negative is 不在. 没有 would negate existence, not location.

src_py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yóu yǒng chí
zh: 公园里没有游泳池。
py: gōng yuán lǐ méi yǒu yóu yǒng chí
en: There is no swimming pool in the park.
why: Existence with 有 becomes 没有. 不有 does not exist.

src: 球场旁边有一家咖啡店。
src_py: qiú chǎng páng biān yǒu yī jiā kā fēi diàn
task: Start with 那家咖啡店 (the known café) and say where it is.
zh: 那家咖啡店在球场旁边。
py: nà jiā kā fēi diàn zài qiú chǎng páng biān
en: That café is next to the pitch.
why: With a known café placed first, the verb must be 在, and the location follows it. 有 would introduce something new.

src: 墙上有一张篮球赛海报。
src_py: qiáng shàng yǒu yī zhāng lán qiú sài hǎi bào
task: Use 挂着 instead of 有.
zh: 墙上挂着一张篮球赛海报。
py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng lán qiú sài hǎi bào
en: On the wall hangs a basketball match poster.
why: The verb is replaced by 挂着 while the place stays first and the new thing last.

src_py: yī wèi xīn jiào liàn lái le qiú duì
task: Fix the word order: the new person comes after the verb.
zh: 球队来了一位新教练。
py: qiú duì lái le yī wèi xīn jiào liàn
en: A new coach has joined the team.
why: The place opens the sentence and the newcomer follows 来了. Trailing the place after 来了 is the English order.

src_py: chāo shì páng biān yǒu yī jiā yín háng
task: Say the thing next to the supermarket is that bank (是, 那家银行).
zh: 超市旁边是那家银行。
py: chāo shì páng biān shì nà jiā yín háng
en: Next to the supermarket is that bank.
why: A definite thing after a place needs 是 to identify it. 有 introduces new things.

src_py: nǐ de qián bāo zài zhuō zi shàng
task: Turn it into a question with 哪儿.
zh: 你的钱包在哪儿？
py: nǐ de qián bāo zài nǎ r
en: Where is your wallet?
why: The question word replaces the place after 在, and the known wallet stays first.

src_py: zhè ér fù jìn yǒu yín háng
task: Turn it into a 有没有 question.
zh: 这儿附近有没有银行？
py: zhè r fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu yín háng
en: Is there a bank near here?
why: The A-not-A form of 有 is 有没有, placed after the place with the noun after it.

src_py: shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
task: Replace 桌子上 with 抽屉 (inside the drawer).
zh: 手机在抽屉里。
py: shǒu jī zài chōu tì lǐ
en: The phone is in the drawer.
why: A drawer is a container, so it needs 里 after it. 上 would be on the drawer.

src_py: yín háng zài xué xiào páng biān
task: Say the bank is across from the school (对面).
zh: 银行在学校对面。
py: yín háng zài xué xiào duì miàn
en: The bank is across from the school.
why: The location word goes after the reference noun: 学校对面.

src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu liǎng bēi kā fēi
task: Use 放着 instead of 有.
zh: 桌子上放着两杯咖啡。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe liǎng bēi kā fēi
en: Two cups of coffee are on the table.
why: The same place-first pattern with 放着 describing how the cups are sitting.

src: 我们学校附近有一个很大的运动场。
src_py: wǒ men xué xiào fù jìn yǒu yī gè hěn dà de yùn dòng chǎng
task: Say there is no sports ground (没有).
zh: 我们学校附近没有运动场。
py: wǒ men xué xiào fù jìn méi yǒu yùn dòng chǎng
en: There is no sports ground near our school.
why: Existence is negated with 没有, and the number-measure and modifier are dropped.

src_py: fáng jiān lǐ yǒu hěn duō qiú
task: Say the room is full of balls (都是).
zh: 房间里都是球。
py: fáng jiān lǐ dōu shì qiú
en: The room is full of balls.
why: 都是 after a place says it is filled with one kind of thing. 有 would only say there are many.

src_py: yī gè qián bāo zài zhuō zi shàng
task: Fix it: a new thing, so the place goes first.
zh: 桌子上有一个钱包。
py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè qián bāo
en: There is a wallet on the table.
why: A new counted thing cannot start the sentence with 在. Place first, 有, then the thing.

s: 一个手机在柜台上。
s_py: yī gè shǒu jī zài guì tái shàng
zh: 柜台上有一个手机。
py: guì tái shàng yǒu yī gè shǒu jī
en: There is a phone on the counter.
why: An indefinite thing cannot be the subject of 在. Start with the place and use 有.

s: 你要的那双球鞋在三楼。
s_py: nǐ yào de nà shuāng qiú xié zài sān lóu
zh: 你要的那双球鞋在三楼。
py: nǐ yào de nà shuāng qiú xié zài sān lóu
en: The pair of sports shoes you want is on the third floor.
why: A known pair goes first and 在 locates it. 有 would be wrong here.

s: 你的手机有柜台上。
s_py: nǐ de shǒu jī yǒu guì tái shàng
zh: 你的手机在柜台上。
py: nǐ de shǒu jī zài guì tái shàng
en: Your phone is on the counter.
why: Locating a known thing needs 在 between the thing and its place. 有 cannot link 你的手机 to 柜台上.

s: 学校对面是一家体育用品店。
s_py: xué xiào duì miàn shì yī jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
zh: 学校对面是一家体育用品店。
py: xué xiào duì miàn shì yī jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
en: Across from the school is a sports goods shop.
why: 是 after a place names what occupies it, even with an indefinite noun.

s: 银行对面在一家体育用品店。
s_py: yín háng duì miàn zài yī jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
zh: 银行对面是一家体育用品店。
py: yín háng duì miàn shì yī jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
en: Across from the bank is a sports goods shop.
why: 在 cannot follow a place. Use 是 (or 有) after it.

s: 我的球拍在桌子。
s_py: wǒ de qiú pāi zài zhuō zi
zh: 我的球拍在桌子上。
py: wǒ de qiú pāi zài zhuō zi shàng
en: My racket is on the table.
why: 桌子 is an object, so it needs 上 after 在.

s: 我姐姐在上海里工作。
s_py: wǒ jiě jiě zài shàng hǎi lǐ gōng zuò
zh: 我姐姐在上海工作。
py: wǒ jiě jiě zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò
en: My older sister works in Shanghai.
why: City names never take 里. 在 alone covers "in".

s: 他们在地铁上看足球比赛。
s_py: tā men zài dì tiě shàng kàn zú qiú bǐ sài
zh: 他们在地铁上看足球比赛。
py: tā men zài dì tiě shàng kàn zú qiú bǐ sài
en: They watch the football match on the subway.
why: 地铁上 is correct: Chinese uses 上 for vehicles.

s: 超市在旁边银行。
s_py: chāo shì zài páng biān yín háng
zh: 超市在银行旁边。
py: chāo shì zài yín háng páng biān
en: The supermarket is next to the bank.
why: The location word follows its noun: 银行旁边.

s: 银行的旁边有一家书店。
s_py: yín háng de páng biān yǒu yī jiā shū diàn
zh: 银行的旁边有一家书店。
py: yín háng de páng biān yǒu yī jiā shū diàn
en: There is a bookshop next to the bank.
why: 的 may be put before a two-syllable location word like 旁边, so this is correct.

s: 桌子的上有一本杂志。
s_py: zhuō zi de shàng yǒu yī běn zá zhì
zh: 桌子上有一本杂志。
py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī běn zá zhì
en: There is a magazine on the table.
why: 上 attaches directly with no 的.

s: 门口站着很多买票的人。
s_py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe hěn duō mǎi piào de rén
zh: 门口站着很多买票的人。
py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe hěn duō mǎi piào de rén
en: Many people buying tickets are standing at the door.
why: Place + verb + 着 + new group is correct.

s: 一张海报挂着在墙上。
s_py: yī zhāng hǎi bào guà zhe zài qiáng shàng
zh: 墙上挂着一张海报。
py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng hǎi bào
en: A poster hangs on the wall.
why: The new thing goes last, with the place first.

s: 今天店里来了很多客人。
s_py: jīn tiān diàn lǐ lái le hěn duō kè rén
zh: 今天店里来了很多客人。
py: jīn tiān diàn lǐ lái le hěn duō kè rén
en: Many customers came to the shop today.
why: Time and place open the sentence, and the newcomers follow 来了.

s: 一个新店员来了我们商店。
s_py: yī gè xīn diàn yuán lái le wǒ men shāng diàn
zh: 我们商店来了一个新店员。
py: wǒ men shāng diàn lái le yī gè xīn diàn yuán
en: A new clerk has joined our shop.
why: The place cannot trail after 来了. It opens the sentence and the newcomer follows.

s: 冰箱里不有牛奶。
s_py: bīng xiāng lǐ bù yǒu niú nǎi
zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶。
py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu niú nǎi
en: There is no milk in the fridge.
why: 有 is only negated with 没.

s: 小王今天不在体育馆，在游泳池。
s_py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān bù zài tǐ yù guǎn zài yóu yǒng chí
zh: 小王今天不在体育馆，在游泳池。
py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān bù zài tǐ yù guǎn zài yóu yǒng chí
en: Xiao Wang is not at the gym today; he is at the pool.
why: 不在 negates 在, and the second clause contrasts with 在.

s: 店长今天没有商店里。
s_py: diàn zhǎng jīn tiān méi yǒu shāng diàn lǐ
zh: 店长今天不在商店里。
py: diàn zhǎng jīn tiān bù zài shāng diàn lǐ
en: The shop manager is not in the shop today.
why: 没有 cannot negate a place; the verb is 不在.

s: 我们小区门口有一家很大的体育用品店，对面是超市。
s_py: wǒ men xiǎo qū mén kǒu yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn duì miàn shì chāo shì
zh: 我们小区门口有一家很大的体育用品店，对面是超市。
py: wǒ men xiǎo qū mén kǒu yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn duì miàn shì chāo shì
en: There is a big sports goods shop at the entrance of our compound, and across from it is a supermarket.
why: 有 introduces the shop and 是 names what is across from it.

s: 你的羽毛球拍是桌子上。
s_py: nǐ de yǔ máo qiú pāi shì zhuō zi shàng
zh: 你的羽毛球拍在桌子上。
py: nǐ de yǔ máo qiú pāi zài zhuō zi shàng
en: Your badminton racket is on the table.
why: Location of a known thing is 在, not 是.
